notes.title: About the next update.
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I'm making this post to talk about what will come in the new update, which will be the beginning of episode 2. This episode will focus on the clubs that the player can join. There will be five options available, each with its own quests, activities, and girls to meet:[/p][list][*][p]Reading[/p][/*][*][p]Tea[/p][/*][*][p]Gardening[/p][/*][*][p]Basketball[/p][/*][*][p]Video games[/p][/*][/list][p]First, the other five main girls of the game will be introduced. Here’s an image of them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45669076/064c493b4b0b4bd9bf41e472606149b55403b06e.png"][/img][/p][p]After meeting all of them and learning which clubs each one belongs to, you will have to choose which club to join. A decision that will change the episode's storyline, as each club will assign its own quests. It will also influence the rest of your gameplay experience, since each club has different activities.[/p][p]After that, the next quest in the game will arrive, giving you the opportunity to get to know one of these two girls in an intimate way. Optional, of course, like all sexual encounters in the game, in case someone doesn’t want to interact with them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45669076/798cb33ea6a7825c4dbfbb189353b3de23d2414a.png"][/img][/p][p]Don’t worry about the girl you haven’t met. Depending on your choices, you’ll be able to meet her sooner or later.[/p][p]The girls I’m going to talk about now won’t be available in the next update, but starting from episode 2. Still, I’d like to start introducing them. Depending on the club you join—reading, tea, gardening, or basketball—you’ll be able to meet one of these four girls, each one linked to one of those clubs. This time, I’m afraid you’ll only be able to meet one of them. If you want to meet the others, you’ll have to replay the game. Which I honestly recommend, because there are so many options—and even more to come—that it’s impossible to see them all in a single playthrough.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45669076/3f6e304848e61656c15178af03bfa2bc1808f584.png"][/img]If you’re wondering why there isn’t a new girl if you join the video games club, it’s because that club includes a special surprise that definitely isn’t in the other clubs. You’ll find out if you join. 100% recommended.[/p][p]Lastly, I wanted to talk to you about one more mechanic. This mechanic probably won’t be fully included in the next update because it’s very large and will take me a lot of time to finish. But I’m talking about the popularity system. At the beginning of episode 2, you’ll unlock a new app called Popularity. This app will let you see a bar graph indicating the popularity of each of your classmates—and yours, of course. You’ll start with 0 points.[/p][p]To increase your popularity, you’ll need to get along better with your classmates. To do this, you’ll have to talk to them every day, give them gifts, and invite them to hang out. As your relationship grows, you’ll be able to decide whether to make it romantic or just friendly. Of course, by making it romantic, you’ll be able to start kissing them, go on dates, and eventually have sex. This will be available with all the girls in the class—which, excluding the main and secondary girls, totals 22. In what other game have you seen such a large number of girls to seduce? And there are still many more to meet.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45669076/c24ccfeca64dfe94ba15d94019f49b6439fecdaa.png"][/img][/p][p]As I said, this big mechanic won’t be fully available in the next update, because I’ll need time to program all 22 girls, their dialogues, gifts, preferences for hanging out, and romantic options. But I’ll work on this gradually and keep you updated on my progress.[/p][p]I also need to work on the part where you can leave the campus to look for different jobs around the city, which will include more girls, as well as money you can spend in stores. There’s a lot to do, so please be patient with me and follow the game’s development. I promise I won’t disappoint you![/p][p]Besides all this, there will also be minor additions, like bug fixes and more random events (currently there’s only one).[/p][p]I hope you like all my ideas and continue supporting the game’s development. Once the next update arrives, early access will be available for a price, and the currently paid update will become free for everyone.[/p][p]Have a great day![/p][p][/p]
